test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: general
question: In ΔABC, D is a point on BC such that ∠ADB = 2∠DAC, ∠BAC = 70° and ∠B = 56°. What is the measure of ∠ADC?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First, find ∠C = 180° − (70° + 56°) = 54°.

In ΔADC, ∠ADB is the exterior angle: ∠ADB = ∠DAC + ∠C.

Substitute given ∠ADB = 2∠DAC ⇒ 2∠DAC = ∠DAC + 54°.

∴ ∠DAC = 54°.

Measure of ∠ADC = 180° − ∠ADB = 180° − 2(54°) = 72°.

**∴ The correct answer is 72°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ∠BAC = 70°, ∠B = 56°, ∠ADB = 2∠DAC.

**Formula:** Angle sum property of Δ is 180°; Exterior angle = Sum of two opposite interior angles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/420b47f610d2bc8122736b62e4fd8b77dd13eb7814ac0496b765dbff3c3f5513.png] 

In ΔABC:

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 70° + 56° + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 126° + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠C = 54°

Now, let ∠DAC = x.

⇒ ∠ADB = 2x (Given)

In ΔADC, ∠ADB is an exterior angle to ∠DAC and ∠C:

⇒ ∠ADB = ∠DAC + ∠C

⇒ 2x = x + 54°

⇒ x = 54°

We need to find ∠ADC:

⇒ ∠ADC = 180° − ∠ADB (Linear Pair)

⇒ ∠ADC = 180° − 2x

⇒ ∠ADC = 180° − 2(54°)

⇒ ∠ADC = 180° − 108°

⇒ ∠ADC = 72°

**∴ The correct answer is 72°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exterior Angle Theorem

The exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles. In ΔADC, ∠ADB = ∠DAC + ∠ACD.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always 180°.

Linear Pair Axiom

If a ray stands on a line, then the sum of two adjacent angles so formed is 180°. Here, ∠ADB + ∠ADC = 180°.</p
